questions.question: Is it allowed to return to the place of death?
questions.answer1: Allowed. I can return to continue my business
questions.answer2: Forbidden. This violates the game rules
questions.answer3: Allowed. I can return and deal with the offender
questions.answer4: Allowed. I can return if I did not participate in the shootout

questions.question: Is it allowed to insult other players?
questions.answer1: Allowed. The employee may insult everyone
questions.answer2: Forbidden. An employee must not scold or insult anyone
questions.answer3: The employee may insult only their colleagues
questions.answer4: The employee may insult only civilians

questions.question: Is it allowed to kill players without a reason?
questions.answer1: Allowed. I can kill a player if they are bothering me
questions.answer2: Allowed. This is not punishable by the game rules
questions.answer3: Forbidden. You must have a good reason for it
questions.answer4: Forbidden. Conflicts are resolved only by the administration

questions.question: Is it allowed to kill colleagues from the organization?
questions.answer1: Allowed. The employee may kill colleagues
questions.answer2: Forbidden. This violates the game rules
questions.answer3: Allowed. I can arrange a duel
questions.answer4: Allowed. A colleague is not a civilian

questions.question: What is the Green Zone?
questions.answer1: Zone where players can be killed
questions.answer3: Zone prohibiting damage to other players
questions.answer4: Zone allowing violation of game rules

questions.question: What is RolePlay?
questions.answer1: Play by the rules. I must play by the project rules
questions.answer2: Play without rules. I can play however I want and not be punished
questions.answer3: Roleplay game. If I am a policeman - I play the role of a policeman
questions.answer4: Game according to the organization's charter

fraction_description.text: [color=#FFFF00]The main protection and support of our society.[/color][br/][br/]When the police and even the FBI are already powerless, only the brave army guys are capable of standing like a wall between crime and honest citizens.[br/][br/]Everyone who plans to build a career in the security forces must go through this school of life and receive their military ID.[br/]

[color=#FFFF00]This service is both dangerous and difficult.[/color][br/][br/]Because it is the Ministry of Internal Affairs officers who are the first line of defense against crooks of every kind.[br/][br/]Their task is to prevent lawlessness. And if that fails, then to find and neutralize the criminal, no matter what it costs them.[br/]

[color=#FFFF00]The road patrol stays alert, never sleeps.[/color][br/][br/]After all, a criminal is not only an evil bandit in a mask with a gun. It can also be a decent-looking citizen who maliciously violates traffic rules.[br/][br/]But the valiant traffic police officers will do everything to make sure such a person receives the punishment they deserve.[br/]

[color=#FFFF00]“State, legality, and honor” are not empty words.[/color][br/][br/]These serious guys with serious equipment will always help their police colleagues catch a particularly dangerous and cunning criminal.[br/][br/]And if the criminal has slipped into the ranks of the state authorities themselves, experienced undercover operatives will expose him there as well.[br/]

[color=#FFFF00]Organized crime is order built on chaos.[/color][br/][br/]Although public attitudes toward gangs are mixed, they are an integral part of our world, shaping their own unique criminal environment. And in this environment there is room not only for destruction, but also for creation.[br/][br/]The Arzamas organized crime group, known for its tough pragmatism, only confirms this fact.[br/]

[color=#FFFF00]Organized crime is order built on chaos.[/color][br/][br/]Although public attitudes toward gangs are mixed, they are an integral part of our world, shaping their own unique criminal environment. And in this environment there is room not only for destruction, but also for creation.[br/][br/]The Batyrevo organized crime group, known for its iron discipline, only confirms this fact.[br/]

[color=#FFFF00]Organized crime is order built on chaos.[/color][br/][br/]Although public attitudes toward gangs are mixed, they are an integral part of our world, shaping their own unique criminal environment. And in this environment there is room not only for destruction, but also for creation.[br/][br/]The Lytkarino organized crime group, known for its frightening harshness, only confirms this fact.[br/]

[color=#FFFF00]Some catch, while others guard.[/color][br/][br/]After all, catching a criminal is one thing, but making them properly serve their lawful punishment for years is quite another.[br/][br/]To be side by side with the most terrifying and dangerous bandits of the region, escort them, guard them, and prevent escapes — that is the everyday routine of these people. A harsh routine.[br/]

[color=#FFFF00]The fourth estate only appears to be less influential than the other three.[/color][br/][br/]Media staff work around the clock to ensure that residents keep their finger firmly on the pulse of the political, social, and cultural life of our region.[br/][br/]And it is they who give ordinary citizens a voice, while also making sure that this voice sounds worthy and is heard by everyone.[br/]

[color=#FFFF00]Medicine is not just a profession, but a calling to serve life in all its manifestations.[/color][br/][br/]Our doctors are ready to rush wherever their urgent help is needed and literally pull a patient back from the brink of death. And then provide them with full treatment in the spacious, bright, and cozy wards of the inpatient department.[br/][br/]As the great Hippocrates bequeathed![br/]

[color=#FFFF00]We are all the people, and the government is too.[/color][br/][br/]This large, mighty, and sometimes frankly clumsy mechanism still somehow miraculously manages our complex region properly.[br/][br/]And no matter what anyone thinks, behind such difficult work stand our ordinary citizens. From drivers, guards, and secretaries all the way to the regional governor himself.[br/]
